title: Psychedelic Skull Dreamscape
description: A surreal painting featuring a glowing green skull with purple interior in the foreground, surrounded by iridescent bubbles. A white wolf stands on the left near a colorful Spanish-style building with yellow and pink walls, while a giant green mushroom with a face dominates the right side against a swirling pink and purple background.
